name: Quicksilver Cash Rewards
balance_transfer_fee: $0 at the standard Transfer APR; 3% during the 0% intro period, or 4% at any other promotional APR Capital One may offer

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $500 in purchases in the first 3 months from account opening

verdict.text: No annual fee, flat 1.5% cash back: an easy long-term keep

earn_rates.category: Hotels, vacation rentals & rental cars, via Capital One Travel

earn_note: The 1.5% flat base with no rotating categories is the whole pitch, plus 5% on Capital One Travel and Capital One Entertainment bookings. Third parties report select accounts moving to the Discover network with 3% at grocery stores and gas stations, but no Capital One document confirms it.

redemption_options.method: Statement credit, check, or gift cards

points.note: Straight 1¢-per-point cash back with no minimum redemption and no expiration while the account stays open. There's no premium-card multiplier to chase since this isn't part of a transferable Capital One Miles pool.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer currency: this is straight cash back, not Capital One Miles.

insurance.detail: Doubles warranties of ≤24 months, adding up to 24 further months
Up to $1M · when fare is charged to the card
$1,500 per insured person on non-refundable common carrier tickets
Delay $100/day up to $300 · lost luggage $1,500/incident (Mastercard) or $3,000/trip (Discover)

protection_note: A solid suite for a no-fee card: purchase protection, extended warranty, price protection, trip cancellation and interruption up to $1,500 per person, baggage delay and lost luggage cover, and $1M of travel accident insurance. No trip delay, emergency medical or cell phone cover. Limits differ between the Mastercard and Discover versions, so check your own Guide to Benefits.
rental_note: Secondary auto rental collision/theft coverage, up to 31 days, pays after your personal auto policy. Decline the counter's CDW/LDW and charge the entire rental to this card to activate it. Excluded vehicles depend on your guide. On the Discover version, coverage is primary outside your country of residence and excludes expensive, exotic and antique cars.

status_perks.name: Hertz Five Star status
status_perks.note: Skip-the-counter access and a wider vehicle selection at select Hertz locations, a nice-to-have, not a real upgrade guarantee.

services.name: Complimentary concierge
services.detail: 24/7, 365-day concierge for dining, entertainment, and travel arrangements.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

benefits.text: Earns cash back on their spend (into your account)
Same purchase protection as the primary card

additional_cards.note: No cost to add users: a simple way to consolidate household spend onto the flat 1.5% base.

timeline.text: Reported by third parties, with no Capital One document found: select Quicksilver and QuicksilverOne accounts moving to the Discover network, adding 3% at grocery stores and gas stations.
Capital One completes its acquisition of Discover Financial Services, setting up the network migration above.
